title: The Cousin's Claim
text: A cousin from a branch thought dead these thirty years arrives with papers, a claim on the House's name, and the founder's own eyes.

outcomes.text: They take the purse and smile with too many teeth. They do not go far.
Steel settles it at dawn. The claim is torn up and the cousin is buried in the family plot, where they say they belonged all along.
Honor is satisfied, at the cost of a scar and a bad Year. The cousin laughs as they bleed, and the laugh is the founder's.
The cousin joins the household with their papers and their grudges, and the old portraits seem to turn toward them.
